export const searchedArticles = pgTable("searched_articles", {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    headline: text("headline"),
    body: text("body"),
    search_vector: customType({ dataType() { return 'tsvector'; } })("search_vector").generatedAlwaysAs(sql`setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce("headline", '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce("body", '')), 'B')`),
    search_vector_text: text("search_vector_text").generatedAlwaysAs(sql`coalesce("headline", '') || ' ' || coalesce("body", '')`)
}, (table) => ([
    pgPolicy("searched_articles_default_admin_read", { as: "permissive", for: "select", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),

export const extremelyLongCollectionSlugForIdentifierTruncationRelations = drizzleRelations(extremelyLongCollectionSlugForIdentifierTruncation, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "correspondingOrganizationalUnit": one(categories, {
        fields: [extremelyLongCollectionSlugForIdentifierTruncation.correspondingOrganizationalUnitId],
        references: [categories.id],
        relationName: "extremely_long_collection_slug_for_identifier_truncation_correspondingOrganizationalUnitId"
    })
}));

export const pinnedNamesRelations = drizzleRelations(pinnedNames, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "category": one(categories, {
        fields: [pinnedNames.explicitCategoryKey],
        references: [categories.id],
        relationName: "pinned_names_explicitCategoryKey"
    })
}));

export const productsRelations = drizzleRelations(products, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "primaryCategory": one(categories, {
        fields: [products.primaryCategoryId],
        references: [categories.id],
        relationName: "products_primaryCategoryId"
    }),
    "categories": many(categoriesProducts, { relationName: "categories" }),
    "tags": many(productsTags, { relationName: "tags" }),
    "statuses": many(productsStatuses, { relationName: "statuses" })
}));

export const categoriesProductsRelations = drizzleRelations(categoriesProducts, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "product_id": one(products, {
        fields: [categoriesProducts.product_id],
        references: [products.id],
        relationName: "categories"
    }),
    "category_id": one(categories, {
        fields: [categoriesProducts.category_id],
        references: [categories.id],
        relationName: "categories_products_category_id"
    })
}));

export const productsTagsRelations = drizzleRelations(productsTags, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "product_id": one(products, {
        fields: [productsTags.product_id],
        references: [products.id],
        relationName: "tags"
    }),
    "tag_id": one(tags, {
        fields: [productsTags.tag_id],
        references: [tags.id],
        relationName: "products_tags_tag_id"
    })
}));

export const productsStatusesRelations = drizzleRelations(productsStatuses, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "product_id": one(products, {
        fields: [productsStatuses.product_id],
        references: [products.id],
        relationName: "statuses"
    }),
    "status_id": one(statuses, {
        fields: [productsStatuses.status_id],
        references: [statuses.id],
        relationName: "products_statuses_status_id"
    })
}));

export const teamsRelations = drizzleRelations(teams, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "players": many(playersTeams, { relationName: "players" })
}));

export const playersTeamsRelations = drizzleRelations(playersTeams, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "team_id": one(teams, {
        fields: [playersTeams.team_id],
        references: [teams.id],
        relationName: "players"
    }),
    "player_id": one(players, {
        fields: [playersTeams.player_id],
        references: [players.id],
        relationName: "players_teams_player_id"
    })
}));

export const tables = { accounts, addresses, adminLedger, books, categories, children, extremelyLongCollectionSlugForIdentifierTruncation, inventoryItems, looseRows, pinnedNames, players, products, categoriesProducts, productsTags, productsStatuses, searchedArticles, shelves, statuses, suppliers, tags, teams, playersTeams, tenantDocuments, touchedRows, translations, urls };
export const enums = { productsStatus, playersTeamsPosition };
export const relations = { extremelyLongCollectionSlugForIdentifierTruncationRelations, pinnedNamesRelations, productsRelations, categoriesProductsRelations, productsTagsRelations, productsStatusesRelations, teamsRelations, playersTeamsRelations };
